task_completion.description: Navigate to the Campaigns module in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM dashboard or the Campaigns list view, with 'Campaigns' visible in the navigation bar or header.

task_completion.description: Enter the Campaign Name, Type, and Status correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field shows 'Q3 Industrial Equipment Launch', 'Status' is set to 'Planning', and 'Type' is set to 'Email' in the campaign creation form.

task_completion.description: Enter the campaign description and budget.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Description' field contains the text about the Q3 2025 product line and the 'Budget' field shows '15000'.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Date' is set to '07/01/2025' and the 'End Date' is set to '09/30/2025' (or equivalent regional format like 2025-07-01).
The UI shows a 'Detail View' of the saved campaign or a success message indicating the record was created.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The campaign must be named 'Q3 Industrial Equipment Launch'. The type must be 'Email'. The budget is 15000. The start date is 2025-07-01 and end date is 2025-09-30. The status must be 'Planning'. The target list to associate is exactly 'Q3 Industrial Partners'. Ensure the agent actually links this specific target list in the subpanel or wizard.
